prompt: I want to launch a customer referral program for our B2B SaaS product. Help me design the system.
expected_behaviors: Triggers systems-design skill
Asks for measurable end state (not just 'more referrals')
Works backwards to identify what must be true
Runs premortem to identify failure modes
Identifies sprint-ready modules
Creates visual diagram with grouped blocks
Produces summary document

prompt: /systemsdesign - I need to build out our AWS practice at the consulting firm
expected_behaviors: Triggers systems-design skill via explicit command
Asks about measurable outcomes (revenue, certifications, customer count)
Maps dependencies (training, partnerships, go-to-market)
Identifies failure modes specific to professional services
Groups into logical modules (capability building, GTM, operations)
Creates diagram showing practice development stages

prompt: Work backwards with me - I want to hit $1M ARR by end of Q4 2026
expected_behaviors: Triggers on 'work backwards' phrase
Defines what evidence proves $1M ARR achieved
Maps backwards from revenue to customer acquisition to product-market fit
Pressure tests timeline feasibility
Identifies critical path vs parallel workstreams
Highlights early wins that validate model

prompt: Help me think through building a content marketing engine that drives inbound leads
expected_behaviors: Triggers on 'help me think through'
Pushes for specific lead targets and conversion metrics
Maps content production → distribution → conversion funnel
Identifies feedback loops (content quality → engagement → more content ideas)
Runs premortem on failure modes (inconsistent publishing, wrong audience, SEO misses)
Groups into modules like content creation, distribution, measurement

prompt: I have an idea for a fantasy baseball app that aggregates rosters across platforms. Validate this for me.
expected_behaviors: Triggers on 'validate this'
Asks what success looks like (user count, engagement, retention)
Maps technical dependencies (API access, data sync, auth)
Identifies failure modes (API rate limits, platform changes, user adoption)
Defines MVP vs full build modules
Creates technical architecture diagram with implementation phases
